brief: How we got our first 100 customers — no ads, no SEO, just 6 channels.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.headline: 100 Customers With Zero Ad Spend
slots.body: We skipped ads and SEO. Instead, we used six organic channels to land our first 100 paying customers in 90 days.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.title: LinkedIn Direct Outreach
slots.body: We identified 500 ideal prospects and sent personalized connection requests. Thirty percent accepted, and ten became paying customers.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.title: Engage Niche Communities
slots.body: We joined Slack and Reddit groups where our target audience hung out. We answered questions and shared value daily, never pitching.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.title: Launch on Product Hunt
slots.body: We crafted a compelling maker story and launched on a Tuesday. The exposure brought 2,000 visitors and converted twelve customers.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.title: Partner With Complementary Tools
slots.body: We reached out to founders of tools our users already loved. A simple integration page swap sent qualified traffic our way.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.title: Build a Referral Loop
slots.body: We gave every user one free month for each successful referral. Our first ten customers brought in three friends each.

slots.author: Alex Chen
slots.title: Targeted Cold Email
slots.body: We scraped public lists of startups hiring for related roles. A short, honest pitch landed us our final twenty customers.
